title: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.

title: How American Thanksgiving took root — and evolved — in Liberia
summary: The first settlers of Liberia were African Americans who brought along the holiday of Thanksgiving — which has evolved to reflect the history and identity of this new nation.

title: Africa Cup title given back to Senegal after sports court rules against Morocco
summary: Senegal won the Africa Cup on the field in Morocco in January and then lost it in a legal case in March because its players walked off the field in protest in second-half stoppage time.
content: Senegal won the Africa Cup on the field in Morocco in January and then lost it in a legal case in March because its players walked off the field in protest in second-half stoppage time. (Image credit: Youssef Loulidi)

title: China investigates Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
